value.signature: fn charged_price_with_ridge (& mut self , wall : & Computed , numeraire : & Numeraire , evidence : & ChargeEvidence , verifier : & impl ChargeVerifier ,) -> Result < ChargedPrice , NumericError >

review.body: { let result = (| | { if self . comparisons . reserve_attempt (1) . is_err () { return Err (NumericError :: Indecisive) ; } let envelope = self . ridge_envelope (evidence) ? ; verifier . replay (evidence) ? ; let (lower , upper) = envelope . ok_or (NumericError :: Indecisive) ? ; if wall . exact . value . compare (& lower , & mut self . budget) ? . is_lt () { return Err (NumericError :: BelowFloor) ; } if wall . exact . value . compare (& upper , & mut self . budget) ? . is_lt () { return Err (NumericError :: Indecisive) ; } Ok (ChargedPrice { wall : wall . clone () , numeraire : numeraire . clone () , price : self . per_action (wall , numeraire) ? , floor : Floor :: RidgeImage , ridge : Some (Box :: new (evidence . clone ())) , }) }) () ; if result . is_err () { crate :: refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: The closed public ridge transcript, exact wall and named numeraire are public evidence. Independent replay is a declared verifier obligation, not an unchecked comparison verdict. Records checks the complete defining envelope and retains only the submitted rational charge; graph reconstructs numerical evidence. No secret or deployment authority enters.
